notes.text: Stolen Vehicle Report: Complainant Ama Boateng (P-004) reported white Toyota Hilux (GT-4521-23) stolen from Cantonments. Vehicle flagged on ANPR cameras and subsequently traced to suspect Kofi Boateng (P-002) in armed robbery operations.

Vehicle Surveillance (V-001): White Toyota Hilux (GT-4521-23) driven by suspect Kofi Boateng (P-002) in the robbery was traced to civilian complainant Ama Boateng (P-004), who reported the vehicle stolen in CASE-00022. Suspects operated the stolen vehicle with falsified paperwork.

SMS Intercept Analysis (PR-003): Outbound SMS record PR-003 links to MSISDN 0241111111. Telecommunications carrier investigation confirms this line belongs to Osu mobile money vendor Akua Agyemang (P-034), whose number was hijacked via a social engineering scam call in CASE-00203 and utilized by the robbery crew as an operational burner.

Social Engineering Scam Call & SIM Hijack (PR-017): Vendor Akua Agyemang (P-034) reported that she received a deceptive voice call at her Oxford Street kiosk from a scammer posing as telco agent support. Tricked into entering an authorization code, her SIM on 0241111111 was hijacked virtually and her merchant float drained by suspect Kwame Asante (P-031). The hijacked number was then used in the Accra Mall armed robbery.
